dataset: NYC Open Data NYCHA Public Housing Developments (phvi-damg)
psaSource: NYPD Housing Bureau Compstat Eagle Report, period ending Nov 15, 2026 (development-to-PSA table). Official NYPD PSA command pages list additional precincts whose NYCHA developments that command serves (used only when a development is not named in the Compstat table). The Open Data dataset NYCHA PSA (72wx-vdjr / bvi6-r9nk) is PSA office locations, not coverage polygons.
